scripts.build:gryphon: cd vendor/gryphon && npm install --silent && npm run build --silent && mkdir -p ../../.obsidian/plugins/gryphon && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css ../../.obsidian/plugins/gryphon/ && mkdir -p ../../.obsidian/plugins/gryphon/hooks && cp -r hooks/* ../../.obsidian/plugins/gryphon/hooks/
scripts.build:all: git submodule update --init --recursive vendor/gryphon && npm run build:gryphon && npm run build
scripts.kb:auto-ingest: bin/kb add 2>&1 | tail -50 && python3 scripts/bulk-llm-regen-summaries.py --only-newer-than-mins 5 2>&1 | tail -20
scripts.sync: git pull --autostash --no-rebase --no-edit origin main && npm run build:all && npm run kb:auto-ingest
